name: Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 10 No 21

clue.text: Lose money converting carbolic to this kind of acid
Transport mediation service? Capital!
Workers, never back to the fore, who return to haunt us —
Means of communication with a walrus
Australasian in turn declaring himself a wanderer?
Laced it in differently, but just the same
Perhaps one said as a metaphor (but could just as soon be written)
In TV we hear gentlemen taking first class return are the brainy ones
Half-moon
Jack the menace becomes half-hearted nearer maturity
Lamb-like in appearance, Ophelia namely
Residence provided by London Stock Exchange?
Is Africa doubly so just before dawn?
Give new form to both sides, including oriental style
A couple of rows for its oarsmen
Course for music-maker in composition of air
Argument against the French one raised — always happening
In view of Wagner’s work being led by study team
Trigonometrical ratio of an Aegean island
Send the man with the stop-watch up
Many an obscure utterance in this ancient craft
Furtive sort of hat style
Tour de France
One man’s meat is another man’s hat-band?
Ground facility to aid flier in difficulties
Army man’s land register
Confiscate Ezra’s statement of identity . . .
or the source of Animal Farm, so called
Like dissenters for the present occasion
Addition to the family calls for a drink
